title: review: stop reference-less agent findings in privacy and UI/accessibility leaves
summary: The privacy and UI/accessibility review skills now report only findings backed by a BCQuality knowledge file. Concerns without a reference are omitted instead of being emitted with empty references, which cuts false positives at the cost of at most one true positive.
key_points: al-privacy-review and al-ui-review are limited to knowledge-backed findings
Reference-less agent findings caused 86% of all false positives in the online eval
Expected to remove about 19 false positives and lose at most 1 true positive
Style, performance and upgrade leaves keep their agent-finding channel for now
Only the instructions change; the output contract stays the same
